skills.title: I'm Sorry
skills.anchor: I'm sorry for… please help me…

beats.text: Hi {kidName}! I'm Capy. I live in this pond.
I want to know you! Can I ask you some things?
What do you love the most?
{favorite}! Me too. I love oranges and my bird friend.
What made you happy today?
How do you feel right now?
Thank you for telling me. Now I'll tell you my secret.
I talk to God every day. It's called praying. Let's try together!
You did it! Your first lantern is on the pond.
Hi {kidName}! I'm Capy. Guess what? God is always listening. Always!
Talking to God is called praying. It's just like talking to a friend.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
You just prayed! High five!
Hi again, {kidName}! I prayed in the pond today. Splash!
You can pray anywhere. In bed, in the car, even in the bath.
God hears you everywhere. Let's say hi from right here.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Another lantern for the pond! See you tomorrow.
Hi {kidName}! Today we pick people to pray for.
I pray for my bird friend every day. Who do you love?
Tap three people you want to pray for.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Ask your child: "Who did you pray for today?" Capy will remember these names and ask about them later.
Your prayer people live in the pond now. Bye!
Hi {kidName}! I found a yummy orange today. Thank you, God!
Good things are everywhere. Saying thank you is a prayer too.
What made you smile today? Let's tell God three things.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Thank you prayers make my tummy happy. Bye!
Hi {kidName}! Before I munch, I say a little thank you.
It's called grace. It's short and you can say it every meal.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Try it tonight: let your child lead grace at the dinner table. Two lines is all it takes.
Now you can say grace at dinner. Munch munch!
Hi {kidName}! People are the best gift of all.
Pick two people you love. We'll thank God for them.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
They would love to know you prayed for them.
{kidName}, it's Beacon Day! Seven lanterns light a beacon.
This week you learned Hello and Thank You. Let's pray both!
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
The beacon is shining! You earned a flower for me.
Hi {kidName}! Wiggle your fingers. Blink your eyes. Amazing!
God made your eyes, ears, nose, hands and tongue. Let's say thanks.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Your body is a gift. Take good care of it!
Hi {kidName}. Today I dropped my orange in the mud. Yuck.
But my bird friend shared his seeds. Even hard days have good bits.
When something goes wrong, we can still find one thank you.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
See? God is with you on hard days too.
Hi {kidName}. Can I tell you a secret? I make mistakes too.
Yesterday I splashed my friend and he got cold. I felt bad.
Everybody makes mistakes. Saying sorry is how we fix them.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
God is glad when we say sorry. Well done.
Hi {kidName}! Remember my splashing mistake? Guess what happened.
I said sorry to God. And God forgave me. Right away!
Forgive means: it's okay, let's try again. God always forgives.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Sorry, forgiven, try again. You've got it!
Hi {kidName}. I said sorry to God. Then I said sorry to my friend.
Kind words fix things. Sorry. Thank you. I love you.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Tonight, ask: "Is there anyone you want to say sorry to?" Keep it light. The goal is that sorry feels safe, not scary.
Kind words make hearts warm. Goodnight!
Hi {kidName}. Today we don't talk much. We listen.
Capybaras are very good at being still. Let's be still together.
Breathe in… breathe out… I'm listening, God.
That was peaceful. God likes quiet time with you.
{kidName}, Beacon Day! Hello, Thank You, and I'm Sorry.
Let's pray all three. I'll go first, you follow.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Two beacons shining! You earned a cozy scarf for me.

lessons.title: God Cares About What You Need

beats.text: Hi {kidName}! Today we learn to ask God for help.
God cares about big things and tiny things. You can ask anything.
What would you like help with?
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Asking for help is brave. God heard you.
Hi {kidName}. Sometimes I get scared of thunder. Boom!
When I'm scared, I breathe slowly and tell God.
Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
You are not alone. Never ever.
Hi {kidName}. Some days I feel sad and I don't know why.
It's okay to feel sad. God can hold sad feelings too.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Thank you for sharing your heart with God.
Hi {kidName}! Tomorrow I visit the doctor. My tummy feels fluttery.
Before something big, we can pray: breathe, ask, and go.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Breathe, ask, go! You can do big things.
Hi {kidName}! Who lives in your home? Let's pray for them.
Pick two people from your family. Then we ask God to be with them.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Your family is loved. And so are you.
Hi {kidName}! My bird friend and I pray for each other.
Friends and teachers help us every day. Let's pray for them.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Good friends pray for their friends. That's you!
{kidName}, Beacon Day! Today: the Five-Finger Prayer.
Hold up your hand. Each finger reminds us who to pray for.
Thumb: people close to you. Pointer: helpers. Tall: leaders. Ring: the sick. Pinky: you!
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Three beacons! Your hand is a prayer list now.

lessons.title: Praying for Someone Who Is Sick

beats.text: Hi {kidName}. My friend duck has a cold today. Achoo!
When someone is sick, we ask God to be close and help them feel better.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Your prayer is like a warm blanket for them.
Hi {kidName}! The world is big. God loves everyone in it.
Lots of helpers keep people safe. Let's pray for them.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Your little prayer went all around the world!
Hi {kidName}. Today we listen with our whole body.
Still hands. Still feet. Quiet mouth. Open heart.
Breathe with me. I'm listening, God.
Being still is a prayer too. Well done.
Hi {kidName}! Jesus taught his friends a prayer. It's very old.
People all over the world say it. Let's learn the first part.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Our Father! You're learning a prayer we all share.
Hi {kidName}! Ready for part two? It's about bread and forgiving.
Daily bread means what we need today. Forgive means it's okay, try again.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
You know the whole prayer now. Amazing!
Hi {kidName}. Tonight's prayer is my favorite sleepy prayer.
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Sweet dreams are on the way.
{kidName}, you did it! The whole Meadow is shining!
Hello, Thank You, I'm Sorry, Please Help, Others, Listen. You know them all!
Let's be quiet for a moment. God is listening.
Pond Keeper! A new river biome opens next.
Hi {kidName}. It's sleepy time. Let's say goodnight to God.
Goodnight, {kidName}. God is with you all night long.
Hi {kidName}! Sniff sniff. Something smells yummy in the kitchen.
Before we eat, we say thank you. That's a kitchen prayer!
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Yum! Thank you prayers taste even better than oranges.
Good morning, {kidName}! Stretch! Yawn! A brand new day.
The first thing I do every day is say hi to God.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Say good morning to God tomorrow too. He loves it.
Look, {kidName}! Tiny green sprouts in the garden.
God makes seeds grow. And He grows us too, little by little.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
You grew a little today. I saw it!
We're at the park, {kidName}! Feel the wind? Hear the birds?
Everything you see, God made. Let's say thank you out loud.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Next time you're outside, whisper thank you. God hears.
So many people in the city, {kidName}! Buses, shops, busy feet.
Every person has a name God knows. We can pray for them, even strangers.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
You prayed for a whole city. Wow!
School day, {kidName}! Sometimes things at school feel hard.
When I'm scared, I breathe and ask God for help. Let's practice.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Breathe, ask, go. You've got this.
Vroom! We're in the car, {kidName}. Where are we going?
Wherever we go, God comes too. Let's pray for a safe trip.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Every trip is better with a prayer. Buckle up!
Hi {kidName}! I have two oranges. Who should I share with?
Jesus shared bread with everyone. Sharing is a way to love.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Sharing makes two happy tummies. Bye!
Psst, {kidName}. Sometimes the dark feels scary. Even for me.
Jesus calmed a big storm. He can calm my heart too.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
God is with you in the dark. Sleep tight.
At the park, {kidName}, I saw a kid fall down. What should I do?
Helping is praying with your hands. Let's practice being kind.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Your hands can pray too. High five!
Uh oh, {kidName}. In the big city I lost my bird friend!
The shepherd looked for one little sheep. God looks for us like that.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Found! God always finds us. Thank you, God.
School again, {kidName}! Someone is sitting all alone at lunch.
Jesus loved kids and said: come to me. Let's be that kind of friend.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
A new friend is a gift. Go say hi tomorrow!
Hi {kidName}. I broke a flower pot today and hid in the garden.
Then I remembered: God runs to hug us when we say sorry.
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
Sorry makes hearts new. See you tomorrow.
We prayed in the kitchen, the park, the car, everywhere, {kidName}!
Now you know: any place is a praying place. Let's build on rock!
Now let's be quiet. Breathe in… breathe out… God is right here.
World two complete! The pond is glowing. You did it!

lines.text: Help me be kind to them. Amen.
God is great, God is good.
Let us thank Him for our food. Amen.
Now I lay me down to sleep,
I pray the Lord my soul to keep.
Guide me safely through the night,
and wake me with the morning light. Amen.
Dear God, thank you for my eyes and ears.
Thank you for my hands and feet.
Help me use them for good. Amen.

prayers.title: Thank You on a Hard Day

lines.text: Thank you for staying with me. Amen.
Please forgive me and help me try again.
Thank you for loving me. Amen.
I'm sorry for {mistake}. Please forgive me.
I know you're with me. Amen.
God, I feel scared right now.
You are bigger than my fear. Amen.
Thank you for loving me anyway. Amen.
Please be with me every step.
God, bless the people close to me.
Bless the leaders who guide us.
Bless the sick and the sad.
God, you love the whole world.
Our Father, who art in heaven,
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done,
on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
Thank you for a new day.
Thank you for flowers and bugs and rain.
God, look at this big sky!
Thank you for trees and birds and running.
God, so many people are here.
Please take care of each one.
Help me be kind today. Amen.
God, help me listen and learn.
Help me be brave when it's hard.
Help me be a good friend. Amen.
God, keep us safe on the road.
Thank you for places to go.
God, it's dark but you are here.
Keep my family safe tonight. Amen.

stories.title: The Lost Sheep

pages.text: A shepherd had one hundred sheep. He loved every single one.
One little sheep wandered off and got lost in the hills.
The shepherd left the ninety-nine and went looking. Up and down, calling its name.
He found it! He carried it home on his shoulders, so happy.
Jesus said: God is like that shepherd. He never stops looking for you.

stories.moral: God always comes looking for you. You are never lost to Him.

stories.title: The Kind Stranger

pages.text: A man was walking on a lonely road. Robbers hurt him and left him there.
A busy man walked by. He did not stop.
Another man walked by. He looked away and kept going.
Then a stranger stopped. He cleaned the hurts, gave water, and took him to rest.
Jesus said: be like the kind stranger. Help anyone who needs it.

stories.moral: Being kind to someone who needs help is a prayer with your hands.

stories.title: The Tiny Seed

pages.text: Jesus held up a mustard seed. It was tiny, smaller than a crumb.
Someone planted it in the garden and waited.
It grew, and grew, and grew into a big tree!
Birds came and made nests in its branches.
Jesus said: a little faith grows big. Even tiny prayers grow.

stories.moral: Your small prayer is a seed. God makes it grow.

stories.title: Jesus Calms the Storm

pages.text: Jesus and his friends sailed across the lake in a boat.
A big storm came. Waves splashed in! The friends were scared.
Jesus was asleep. They woke him: Help us!
Jesus stood up and said: Quiet! Be still. The wind stopped.
The friends whispered: even the wind listens to Him.

stories.moral: When you are scared, tell Jesus. He can calm the storm inside you.

stories.title: Five Loaves, Two Fish

pages.text: A huge crowd came to hear Jesus. Everyone was hungry.
A boy had five small breads and two fish. He shared them.
Jesus said thank you to God, and broke the bread.
Everyone ate until they were full. Thousands of people!
There were twelve baskets left over.

stories.moral: Say thank you before you eat, and share what you have. God makes it enough.

stories.title: Zacchaeus in the Tree

pages.text: Zacchaeus was very short and nobody liked him. He took too much money.
Jesus was coming! Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see.
Jesus stopped and said: Zacchaeus, come down. I want to visit your house!
Zacchaeus was so happy. He gave the money back, and more.
Jesus is a friend to everyone, even when others say no.

stories.moral: Jesus wants to be your friend, exactly as you are.

stories.title: Jesus and the Children

pages.text: Moms and dads brought their kids to see Jesus.
The helpers said: go away, Jesus is too busy for kids!
Jesus said: No! Let the children come to me.
He hugged them and blessed them, one by one.
Jesus said: kids know how to trust. Everyone should be like them.

stories.moral: You are never too small to talk to God. He loves your voice.

stories.title: The Son Who Came Home

pages.text: A son took his money and ran far away from home.
He spent it all. Soon he was hungry and sad.
He thought: I will go home and say I'm sorry.
His dad saw him far away and ran to hug him!
They had a party. Dad said: my son was lost, now he's found.

stories.moral: When you say sorry, God runs to hug you. Always.

stories.title: Two Houses

pages.text: Jesus told about two builders.
One built his house on sand. Easy and fast!
The other built on rock. It took longer.
Rain came, wind blew. The sand house fell down. Splash!
The rock house stood strong. Jesus said: listen to my words, and you are on rock.

stories.moral: Praying every day builds your house on rock.

stories.title: The Farmer and the Seeds

pages.text: A farmer threw seeds everywhere.
Some fell on the path. Birds ate them.
Some fell on rocks. They dried up in the sun.
Some fell in weeds and got squished.
Some fell on good soil and grew tall. A hundred times more!

stories.moral: Keep your heart like good soil: listen, and God's words will grow.
